author: Rob Braxman Tech
description:
Here's the story of a newbie on Home Automation firing up Home Assistant and various IOT devices with zero knowledge at the beginning. Follow the the experience and now I know what's up! I've avoided Internet of Things (IOT) devices because they are such privacy invaders. But you can do Home Automation the Open Source way with no cloud dependencies of any sort. Follow me on my journey.
